label: Gmail web and Gmail mobile apps
proves: The artifact includes inline typography and fluid dimensions that remain available if a client ignores a stylesheet or media query. The suite does not execute Gmail's sanitizer.

expectations.because: Inline heading typography remains available if a Gmail viewing path ignores a style block.
Without an inline font-size, a stripped stylesheet leaves headings at the client default scale.
Body copy has to survive stylesheet removal with its face, size, and colour intact.
An inline text colour keeps the resolved design available if a style block is ignored.
An inline max-width lets the container shrink when a media query is unavailable.
Gmail renders at the device width, so an image has to be fluid up to its intrinsic size rather than fixed.
Gmail leaves descender whitespace under an inline image inside a table cell.
An inline column width preserves the layout if a class selector is ignored.
The non-MSO button anchor needs its own typography; the VML branch is reserved for Word-based Outlook.
A remote stylesheet is an avoidable dependency for core layout and may be unavailable in an email client.
Gmail surfaces list management from the message body when the footer link is a real absolute destination.
Navigation labels keep their resolved font if a style block is ignored.

limitations.detail: Columns_Renderer emits the column-gap media query as a style element inside a table cell. This suite cannot establish whether Gmail applies that body-level style in each viewing path.
limitations.degrades_to: If that style is ignored, stacked columns lose their vertical gap on mobile. Actual behavior needs client rendering evidence.

limitations.detail: The matrix does not load remote font stylesheets in Gmail.
limitations.degrades_to: If a font is unavailable, text uses the inline fallback stack.

limitations.detail: Navigation_Renderer emits its mobile stacking media query as a style element in the message body. This suite cannot establish whether Gmail applies that body-level style in each viewing path.
limitations.degrades_to: If the rule is ignored, navigation links remain in their table row at narrow widths. Actual behavior needs client rendering evidence.

limitations.detail: These expectations inspect compiler output; Gmail's sanitizer is not run here.
limitations.degrades_to: Actual Gmail rendering is unproven by this matrix.
